# Analytic spectrum of an algebra of finite presentation {#section-1}

\oldpage{19-01}

::: {.rmenv title="Definition 1" latex="{Definition 1}"}
Let $S$ be a ringed space.
We say that an $\OO_S$-algebra $\cal{A}$ is of finite presentation if every $s\in S$ admits a neighbourhood $U$ such that $\cal{A}|U$ is isomorphic to a sheaf of the form
$$
  \frac{(\OO_S|U)[t_1,\ldots,t_n]}{(f_1,\ldots,f_m)}
$$
with $f_1,\ldots,f_m\in\Gamma(U,\OO_S[t_1,\ldots,t_n])$.
:::

That is, $\cal{A}$ is locally generated over $\OO_S$ by a finite number of sections subject to a finite number of relations.

We are interested in the case where $S$ is an analytic space, over a complete valued non-discrete base field $k$.
